title: category-ip-geo-detect: add more ip checkers, mirrors and apis
body:
Adds 1478 domains to `category-ip-geo-detect`. Only additions, nothing removed or reordered.

Big one, so it's split into 16 commits, one category each. If some category doesn't fit the list, it can be dropped on its own.

**How it was collected**

- Existing lists: MISP whats-my-ip, maltrail ipinfo trail, Sigma/Elastic ip lookup rules, router and proxy rule sets (Clash, Surge, Shadowrocket), DDNS and IP check tools source code
- Search in 40+ languages, plus `site:` per ccTLD
- Every brand already in the list checked against ~85 TLDs for missed mirrors

**How it was checked**

- Each domain loaded live twice from two unrelated networks, one ipv4-only and one ipv4/ipv6, to rule out fluctuations
- Kept only if the page returns/shows the visitor's IP, or it's clearly an IP lookup / geo API service
- Excluded on purpose: VPN sellers' "what is my ip" pages, DNS services, hosting companies, general tool sites, port/whois tools, browser-detection and fingerprint-only sites, parked and dead domains, and disguised ip-logger short link domains
- CN hosted ones are marked `@cn`
- `go run ./` and `go test ./...` pass

**Notes**

- Overlaps with #4140 on `2ip.me`, `whatismyip.com.tw`, `whatismyip.unc.edu`. Whichever merges second needs a trivial rebase.
- Old entries that look dead now are left as is on purpose.

body:
This PR updates the domain list for **Beget LLC (AS198610)**, a Russian hosting, cloud infrastructure, and CDN provider.

### Included domains

**1. Core services and DNS**
- `beget.com`, `beget.ru`, `beget.pro` — official websites, hosting control panel, API, and DNS infrastructure.
  - Ref: [Company details](https://beget.com/ru/details), [DNS server documentation](https://beget.com/ru/kb/how-to/domains/izmenenie-ns-serverov-dlya-domennogo-imeni)

**2. Cloud infrastructure and CDN**
- `beget.cloud` — cloud services and S3-compatible object storage.
  - Ref: [S3 object storage documentation](https://beget.com/ru/kb/manual/obektnoe-hranilishche-s3-v-beget)
- `begetcdn.cloud` — domain zone used for Beget CDN distribution.
  - Ref: [CDN documentation](https://beget.com/ru/kb/manual/cdn)
- `beget.app` — technical domains for applications deployed through Beget Cloud Marketplace.
  - Ref: [Beget Cloud Marketplace — Node.js](https://beget.com/en/cloud/marketplace/nodejs)

**3. Hosting technical domains**
- `beget.tech`, `bget.ru` — technical domains used for customer websites and related hosting services.
  - Ref: [Website migration and technical domains](https://beget.com/ru/kb/how-to/sites/perenos-sajta-k-nam)

**4. Additional company and product domains**
- `beget.de`, `beget.hosting`, `beserver.ru`, `xn--90aefb9d.xn--p1ai` (`бегет.рф`) — additional domains associated with Beget LLC (`193.168.47.254`).
  - Ref: [AS198610 — Beget LLC (BGP.he.net)](https://bgp.he.net/AS198610)
- `sprut.io` — web-based file manager developed by Beget.
  - Ref: [Beget Sprutio — GitHub repository](https://github.com/LTD-Beget/sprutio), [File manager manual](https://beget.com/ru/kb/manual/fajlovyj-menedzher)

The list covers Beget's main web properties, hosting-related technical domains, cloud services, CDN infrastructure, and associated product domains.

---

Этот PR обновляет список доменов для **ООО «Бегет» (AS198610)** — российского провайдера услуг хостинга, облачной инфраструктуры и CDN.

### Включённые домены

title: chinamobile, chinatelecom, chinabroadnet: add 3GPP public domains
body:
## Background

`category-ru` already lists `mcc250.pub.3gppnetwork.org` (Mobile IMS) for Russian operators, but there is no equivalent for mainland China operators. To find out which mainland operators actually hold a delegation under `pub.3gppnetwork.org`, I ran a full NS scan of `mnc000` – `mnc999` under both `mcc460` and `mcc461`.

Note: every name under `mccXXX.pub.3gppnetwork.org` returns `NOERROR` even when nothing is delegated there, so only names that return actual NS records are counted as delegated.

## Scan results

| Operator | Delegated zone | NS servers | NS ASN |
|---|---|---|---|
| China Mobile | `mnc000.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` | `ns.cnmobile.net`, `ns2.cnmobile.net`, `ns1.cmmobile.cn`, `ns2.cmmobile.cn` | AS9808 |
| China Mobile | `mnc002.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` | same as above | AS9808 |
| China Mobile | `mnc004.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` | same as above | AS9808 |
| China Mobile | `mnc007.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` | same as above | AS9808 |
| China Telecom | `mnc011.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` | `ns1.chinanet.cn`, `ns2.chinanet.cn`, `ns3.chinanet.cn` | AS4134 |
| China Broadnet | `mnc015.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` | `vip3.alidns.com`, `vip4.alidns.com` (Alibaba Cloud DNS) | AS45102 |

- No delegation exists for any other MNC under `mcc460` (including China Unicom's `001` / `006` / `009`), or for any MNC under `mcc461`.
- Each zone's SOA is served authoritatively by the NS servers listed above, so the delegations are live, not lame.
- The results are identical across Google / Cloudflare DoH (queried from outside China) and `223.5.5.5`, `119.29.29.29`, `202.103.224.68` (queried over UDP 53 from inside China).

## ePDG

`epdg.epc.mncXXX.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` returns `NXDOMAIN` (A and AAAA) for all 6 delegated MNCs, answered authoritatively by each operator's own NS. It is not known whether these operators publish any other records in these zones besides ePDG.

## Why no `@!cn`

This PR is not the usual case of "the domain belongs to a mainland China company and resolves to mainland China IPs": the parent domain is managed by 3GPP, and the ePDG names currently return `NXDOMAIN`. Still, these subdomains are delegated to the name servers of mainland China ISPs, and they will very likely only ever be used for those operators' domestic services. They are therefore added without `@!cn`, and end up in `geolocation-cn` through the operator lists.

## Changes

- `chinamobile`: `mnc000`, `mnc002`, `mnc004`, `mnc007` `.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org`
- `chinatelecom`: `mnc011.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org`
- `chinabroadnet`: `mnc015.mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org`

## Open question: add `mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` as a whole?

I'm not sure whether `mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` itself should also be added to the cn lists (e.g. `geolocation-cn`, which `geosite:cn` includes), the same way `category-ru` lists `mcc250.pub.3gppnetwork.org`. Virtually every subdomain under it is bound to be delegated to a mainland China ISP, so adding it to the cn lists seems reasonable.

It would also cover future delegations. If China Unicom later registers a delegation of its own, or a new operator appears in mainland China, that operator's `pub.3gppnetwork.org` zone would not match any list generated by this project under the per-MNC approach in this PR. Adding `mcc460.pub.3gppnetwork.org` to the cn lists avoids that problem.

If you have any thoughts on this, I'm happy to revise the PR further.

## Disclosure

This PR was prepared with the assistance of AI, which is disclosed here. It has been reviewed, verified, and approved for submission by a human; it was not generated fully autonomously by AI.

## See also

- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mobile_country_code
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wi-Fi_calling

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01XhAhSp4FJ44KxF1KjeBNto

title: google-deepmind: add waa-pa & people-pa under clients6.google.com
body:
### What
Add two `*-pa.clients6.google.com` subdomains that current Gemini frontends
(both `gemini.google.com` and `aistudio.google.com`) call but the existing
`google-deepmind` list does not match:

- `full:waa-pa.clients6.google.com`
- `full:people-pa.clients6.google.com`

### Why
`clients6.google.com` is Google's shared host for `-pa` (private API) gRPC
endpoints. Different products mount different `*-pa` subdomains under it. The
existing list only covers AI Studio's three `alkali*-pa` endpoints. Modern
Gemini frontends additionally call:

- **waa-pa.clients6.google.com** — *Web Abuse Arbiter*: the gRPC
  `google.internal.waa.v1.Waa/Create` integrity-token service. Without it,
  the Gemini web UI loads but message sends are blocked with region/abuse
  errors. This domain is explicitly listed in Google's own Gemini app
  firewall allowlist: https://support.google.com/a/answer/15627649
- **people-pa.clients6.google.com** — Google's *Internal People API*
  (distinct from the public `people.googleapis.com`). Used by Gemini for
  account/profile context and `@mention` features. Documented as
  "Internal People API" in
  https://github.com/google/google-api-javascript-client/issues/608

### Why `full:` (not a bare suffix)
PR #3292 proposes replacing the existing `full:alkali*` entries with a bare
`clients6.google.com` suffix. While simpler, that would also route
`*.clients6.google.com` subdomains used by Gmail, Drive, Photos,
Workspace add-ons, etc. — products that users may want on a different
outbound. Sticking with `full:` keeps the list narrowly scoped to Gemini's
known backends; new Gemini subdomains can be added one at a time as they
are observed in the wild.

### Verification
Captured live from a Gemini session: both subdomains appear in DevTools
network traffic and the Gemini "region not supported" errors reported in
issues #2378, #2938 and #3188 go away once these two are routed through the
same outbound as the rest of `google-deepmind`.

Refs: #2938, #2378, PR #3292

## Summary

Add `szu.app` and `szu.moe` to `category-education-cn`.

Both domains are used by services of the Information Network Security Association under Shenzhen University Information Center.

## Reason

These domains are intended primarily for users in mainland China.

Although their public DNS records are not necessarily hosted on mainland-China cloud IP ranges, the service paths are optimized for mainland-China access.

In addition, some subdomains may resolve to private/internal addresses for campus or internal services. If these domains are routed through an overseas proxy, it may cause incorrect routing or make those internal services unreachable.

Adding the parent domains is sufficient because domain rules also cover their subdomains, so separate wildcard entries such as `*.szu.app` and `*.szu.moe` are unnecessary.

## Change

# 深圳大学信息中心信息网络安全协会
szu.app
szu.moe

title: bybit: add ffbbbdc6…, ffe390….de, wsot2022.com
body:
Adds three Bybit domains to `data/bybit`, with ownership evidence from Certificate Transparency logs.

- `ffe390afd658c19dcbf707e0597b846d.de`: certificate [crt.sh 29308854634](https://crt.sh/?id=29308854634) (Amazon, 2026-09-09) has CN `*.bybit.com` and also covers `*.ffe390afd658c19dcbf707e0597b846d.de`. Hosts seen in use include `sc-abtest.`, `pup-resource.` and `option.`.
- `ffbbbdc6d3c353211fe2ba39c9f744cd.com`: certificate [crt.sh 8756607310](https://crt.sh/?id=8756607310) (Amazon, 2023-02-27) covers both this domain and `*.ffe390afd658c19dcbf707e0597b846d.de`. The live certificate on `api.` / `sc-datasink.` is OV-issued to `O=WECHAIN FINTECH PTE LTD, L=Singapore`. This is Bybit app analytics (`sc-datasink`).
- `wsot2022.com`: the site for Bybit's World Series of Trading 2022. Certificate [crt.sh 29517246473](https://crt.sh/?id=29517246473) (2026-09-22) covers both `*.wsot2022.com` and `*.ffbbbdc6d3c353211fe2ba39c9f744cd.com`. Registrar: CSC Corporate Domains. `api.wsot2022.com` is still in use.

These domains show up in real Bybit app traffic, and the current list misses them.

Related: #3985 proposes `wsot2022.com` and `ng-dex.com` without a source. This PR gives evidence for `wsot2022.com`. I couldn't confirm who owns `ng-dex.com`, so it is not included here.

title: binance: add app fallback domains
body:
Adds Binance domains that are missing from `data/binance`.

Source: the Binance app's own domain config, `https://d3sknckuh1o9tg.cloudfront.net/app/dynamic-config.json`. The app downloads this file to get its API endpoints (`apiDomainList`: `www.binance.com`, `www.binance.me`) and the list of domains it trusts for fallback and WebView (`domainWhitelist.suffix`). The list already includes `binance.com`, `binance.me`, `binance.info`, `binance.co`, `binancezh.info`, `binance.charity` and `bnappweb.black`, which are all in this file today.

Added:
- `binance.click`, `binance.cx`, `binance.sh`, from `domainWhitelist.suffix`. All are delegated to AWS Route 53.
- `bnappweb.*` (23 TLDs) and `mokexapp.*` / `mokexweb.*` (10 TLDs), from `domainWhitelist.suffix` and `webViewWebUrlMapping`. The app uses these as its fallback web domains. `bnappweb.black` is already listed. The `bnappweb.*` names were registered together on 2024-10-24, mostly through Amazon Registrar. Live certs: `*.bnappweb.biz`, `www.bnappweb.blue`, `www.bnappweb.cc`, `*.mokexapp.cz`.
- `full:d3sknckuh1o9tg.cloudfront.net`, the CloudFront host that serves the config file itself. It is added as a full match, so the rest of `cloudfront.net` is not affected.

Left out on purpose:
- `binance.top`, `binance.tv`, `bnappzh.co`, `mokexapp.net` and `yshxxy.com` are in the config but don't resolve right now.
- `golvv.net` and `ftnormal00ai.com` only appear in a `networkPolicy` entry of type `AGS`, which is a third-party acceleration service and not owned by Binance.

title: category-ru: include sber
body:
#4132 replaced `include:sber` with `include:sberbank` in `category-bank-ru`. That was the only path by which `sber` reached `category-ru`, so the Sber ecosystem (2GIS, Okko, Zvuk, Megamarket, Jivo, SberAuto, cloud.ru, …) dropped out of `geosite:category-ru`.

This adds `include:sber` to the "Russian companies" section, alongside `yandex`, `mailru-group`, etc. `category-bank-ru` keeps only `sberbank`, as intended by #4132.

Checked locally: the generated `category-ru` grows from 1066 to 1108 entries and contains `2gis.com`, `okko.tv`, `zvuk.com` again.

body:
Refs #4128. Telemetry, crash reporting and logging hosts previously tagged @ads now also carry @telemetry. @ads is kept for backward compatibility. Add missing Azure Application Insights and Microsoft diagnostic endpoints, and include the affected lists in category-telemetry.

让 Claude Sonnet 5.5 简单过了一遍现有的 `@ads`，给非广告归因的遥测加上了 @telemetry。可以使用 geosite:telemetry 来 cover 所有的遥测主机，或者 geosite:category-ads-and-telemetry 来同时覆盖 ads 与 telemetry。

为了后向兼容，暂时没有移除 `@ads` 属性。
